title: The Beryl Lee | Beautiful. Walkable. Best Location
description:
This Germantown Gem is great for everyone from families to friend groups! There are lots of mirrors, desks/vanities in every bedroom, family-friendly games, portable bluetooth speakers, sound machines, and three Smart TV's for streaming. You'll also have tons of Grocery and meal delivery options available in this prime, upscale location. 

This space was purposefully designed with your comfort in mind: super comfy & clean beds and linens, Keurig Coffee, Netflix, complimentary bath toiletries...

The space
This space is compact, but feels large and very well-designed to be very comfortable for groups of 6. 
Just keep in mind that there's only 1 bathroom. We've had plenty of groups of 6 stay here with no problems, but it's good for everyone to know that before they get here (:

Other things to note
This apartment is completely private and accessed by your group only, but the outdoor spaces here are shared with the two other apartments in this triplex house.
